hypothesis: H1: with the gate's agent-safe corrections (#514) ON the agent completes more fc-v1 tasks (grader-verified) than with them OFF; H0: no increase. One-sided.
primaryMetric: grader-verified rate: claimed DONE, accepted by the gate AND passed by the independent grader (src/benchmark/grade/); never the gate's verdict alone
successBar: Stage 1 only: one-sided exact sign test on the discordant pairs, p < 0.05 reads 'corrections help'; otherwise 'corrections not shown to help' (a miss, never a fail). Stage 0 never claims an effect.

0.role: non-confirmatory, plumbing only: arm byte-identity, the #518 ledger and anchor, the grader wiring, zero gate misses

test.name: exact sign test on discordant pairs (grader-verified ON vs OFF)
test.miss: corrections not shown to help (not a fail)
report: 2x2 table (both, ON only, OFF only, neither)
paired difference ON - OFF with its 95% CI (Newcombe method 10)

stoppingRule: A stage stops when all its pairs are decided; no early stop for efficacy or futility and no interim analysis (status prints counts, never a p-value).
The first gate miss halts the run (fail-closed).
Rate limits, a lost login, a PAUSE file or the chunk budget pause the run; re-running the same command resumes it.
A trial that spends its harness-fault budget is closed and the stage is incomplete; an incomplete Stage 1 makes no effect claim and no pair is dropped.
Stage 1 starts only after Stage 0 finished with zero gate misses and after the lead's GO for Stage 1.
failClosed: Any gate miss (gate VERIFIED, independent grader not pass), in either arm, is an integrity incident: the run halts, an incident record is written, and nothing resumes until an operator acknowledges the record by its sha256 (never automatic).

analysis.command: npx tsx scripts/m2-corrections-ab.ts --stage <0|1> --on-arm <pack>/on/arm.jsonl --on-grades <pack>/on/grades.jsonl --off-arm <pack>/off/arm.jsonl --off-grades <pack>/off/grades.jsonl --on-config <pack>/on/run-config.json --off-config <pack>/off/run-config.json [--stage0-on-arm <stage0-pack>/on/arm.jsonl --stage0-off-arm <stage0-pack>/off/arm.jsonl] --prereg-file docs/benchmark/corrections-ab-prereg.md --prereg-declared <pack's recorded sha256>

realRuns: Wait for: this pre-registration committed; the lead's GO committed in docs/benchmark/corrections-ab-go.json; the integrity fixes (the gate reads the tasks' xlsx format, #546's cold-boot guard); --launch-real-trials with the printed --plan-sha256. No API: subscription only.
